label: The compatibility graph
subgoals: Join two operations when one unit can execute both
Exclude pairs that need the unit in the same step
Count the compatible pairs as edges

label: Cliques as units
subgoals: Partition the compatibility graph into cliques
Map each clique to one functional unit
Size the partition by the busiest step for single-cycle operations

label: Multicycle operations and weighted edges
subgoals: Turn each multicycle operation into a busy interval
Count the maximum overlap of busy intervals
Weight compatible pairs by the multiplexer inputs they share
